# POST /api/v1/user/applications/oauth2

Create a new OAuth2 application for the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-167`

## Request

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateOAuth2ApplicationOptions`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | True | Required |
| `confidential_client` | bool | False |  |
| `skip_secondary_authorization` | bool | False |  |
| `redirect_uris` | []string | True | Required, each URI must be valid URL or custom scheme |

## Response

**201** — OAuth2Application

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Application ID |
| `name` | string | Application name |
| `client_id` | string | OAuth2 client ID (UUID) |
| `client_secret` | string | Client secret (only returned on creation) |
| `confidential_client` | bool | Whether client is confidential |
| `skip_secondary_authorization` | bool | Whether secondary auth is skipped |
| `redirect_uris` | []string | Allowed redirect URIs |
| `created` | time | Creation timestamp |

- **400** — Invalid redirect URI or error creating application/secret
